content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Lab Technician post at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Lab Technician post at AIIMS Jodhpur is 17 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report by the specified closing time.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is a 12th pass in Science subjects with a Two-year Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician, or a One-year DMLT with one year of experience, or two years of field/laboratory experience. A B.Sc. degree is considered equivalent to three years of work experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Lab Technician post at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lab Technician role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to appear in person for the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies of documents related to age, qualifications, and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age relaxation provided for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation. The provided data does not specify any age relaxation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve a Walk-in Interview. A written examination may be conducted if a large number of eligible applications are received.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at AIIMS Jodhpur. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The tenure of the Lab Technician post is until 30 November 2026.
